#  Title:CFT_2 in the Bulk
Authors:[Cameron V. Cogburn](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Cogburn,+C+V)
View a PDF of the paper titled CFT$_2$ in the Bulk, by Cameron V. Cogburn
[View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.04303) [HTML (experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2110.04303v1)
> Abstract:We study non-Gaussian bulk 2d CFTs in AdS_2 using boundary CFT techniques and recent results in JT/Schwarzian gravity. We highlight the constraints on the operator content of a theory imposed by the boundary conditions by examining the relation between correlator coefficients and OPE coefficients in the presence of a boundary. We then calculate bulk and boundary correlators for various boundary conditions. Schwarzian techniques are used to calculate gravitational correlators perturbatively in 1/c.
